title: 乐乐送星星回家
subtitle: 一只小兔和一颗迷路的星星
blurb: 一颗小星星从天上掉了下来。小兔乐乐提着灯笼，穿过花园和森林，要把它送回家。

narrator.instruct: 用温柔、缓慢、充满好奇的语气，给小朋友讲睡前故事

artStyle: Children's picture book illustration, soft gouache and watercolor texture with gentle colored-pencil lines, cute rounded shapes, storybook art.
sceneStyle: Warm cozy night palette of deep blue, violet and golden glow.

cover.prompt: A small white bunny girl with long ears and a red knitted scarf sits on a grassy hill at night, hugging a softly glowing golden star with a smiling face, under a huge starry sky with a crescent moon.
cover.subtitle: 萤火绘本 · 第一册

bg-bedroom.prompt: A cozy child's bedroom at night seen from inside: a big arched window in the middle shows a starry night sky with a crescent moon, pink curtains on both sides, patterned violet wallpaper, a wooden floor, soft lamplight.

bg-garden.prompt: A quiet flower garden at night with a white wooden picket fence, round bushes and small flowers, rolling hills behind, a crescent moon in a starry sky.

bg-forest.prompt: A deep enchanted forest at night: tall dark tree trunks, soft blue-green mist, tiny glowing lights floating between the trees, a winding path into the distance.

bg-pond.prompt: A calm pond at night surrounded by reeds and cattails, the crescent moon reflected on the still water, a starry sky above.

bg-hill.prompt: A gentle grassy hill under a huge starry night sky with a crescent moon and a small round tree on the hilltop.

lele.prompt: A small cute white bunny girl named Lele with long upright ears that are pink inside, big round dark eyes, rosy cheeks, a knitted red scarf, standing upright on two feet with her paws relaxed.

star.prompt: A small cute five-pointed golden star character with a gentle smiling face and rosy cheeks, softly glowing.

lantern.prompt: A round red Chinese paper lantern with golden caps and a golden tassel, glowing warmly from inside, hanging from a short bamboo stick.

owl.prompt: A fluffy round brown owl with big amber eyes and little ear tufts, perched on a short branch, friendly expression.

tree.prompt: A round, leafy dark green storybook tree with a sturdy brown trunk and one side branch.

mushroom.prompt: Two cute glowing mushrooms side by side, a tall one with a teal cap with white spots and a small one with a lilac cap.

flower.prompt: A small bunch of three garden flowers, pink, yellow and lavender, with green stems and leaves.

lily.prompt: A single green lily pad seen from directly above, round with one narrow notch, with a small pink lotus flower on it.

frog.prompt: A small cute green frog sitting and smiling, with big friendly eyes.

bed.prompt: A small wooden child's bed seen from the side, with a white pillow and a blue blanket covered in little yellow stars.

pages.heading: 睡不着的夜晚
pages.text: 夜深了， {小兔乐乐:lele/look} 还 没有 {睡着:lele/yawn}。 她 趴在 {窗边:sky/glow}， 忽然 看见 一颗 {小星星:star/fall} 从 天上 {掉:star/fall} 了 下来！
pages.hint: 点点乐乐，再点点那颗小星星。

pages.heading: 花园里的萤火虫
pages.text: 乐乐 提着 {小灯笼:lantern/glow}， 悄悄 走进 {花园:flower/wiggle}。 {萤火虫:fireflies/twinkle} 飞 过来 说： “星星 掉进 {森林:sky/glow} 里 啦！”

pages.heading: 森林里的猫头鹰
pages.text: 森林 里 黑黑的。 {猫头鹰:owl/hoot} 眨了眨 {大眼睛:owl/blink}， 说： “别怕， 跟着 那道 {亮光:star/twinkle} 走。” 乐乐 {点点头:lele/hop}。
pages.hint: 点点猫头鹰，它会咕咕叫。

pages.heading: 池塘边的小星星
pages.text: 在 {池塘:frog/hop} 边， 乐乐 找到了 {小星星:star/glow}。 它 躺在 {荷叶:lily/wiggle} 上， 小声 地 {哭:star/wiggle}： “我 想 回家。”
pages.hint: 点点青蛙，再点点荷叶上的星星。

pages.heading: 送星星回家
pages.text: 乐乐 抱着 {星星:star/glow}， 爬上 最高 的 {山坡:lele/hop}。 她 用力 一 {跳:lele/jump}， 把 星星 {送回:star/rise} 了 {天空:sky/glow}！
pages.hint: 点点星星，帮它飞回天上。

pages.heading: 晚安，星星
pages.text: {星星:star/twinkle} 在 天上 {眨眨眼:star/twinkle}： “谢谢 你， 乐乐！” 乐乐 回到 {小床:bed/bounce}， 甜甜地 {睡着:lele/sleep} 了。

end.heading: 完
end.text: 故事 讲完 啦。 今晚， 你 也 抬头 看看 {星星:star/twinkle} 吧！
end.prompt: 再读一遍，或者回到书架选一本新书。
